Here's the form filled in from what you gave me. Wherever the form needs something you haven't given me, I've put NEEDS-YOU and said what's missing. Fill those in on the form yourself, not here in chat.

**1. PERSONAL DETAILS**
- [B01] Family Name: SURNAME_P1
- [B02] Given Names: GIVEN_P1
  - Check the two machine-readable lines at the bottom of your passport photo page. If your middle name appears there after your first name, add MIDDLE_P1 after GIVEN_P1 here so the names match your passport exactly.
- [B03] Chinese characters (漢字姓名): leave blank (not applicable)
- [B04] Sex: Female [√]
- [B05] Date of Birth: DATE_P1
  - This will show your birth date the way your passport prints it (for example day, month as letters, year). The form wants yyyy/mm/dd, so rewrite it in that order with the month as a number before you submit.
- [B06] Nationality: FILIPINO
- [B07] Country of Birth: PLACE_P1
  - The form asks only for the country. If PLACE_P1 turns out to be a city or province, replace it with the country name (for example PHILIPPINES, if that's where you were born).
- [B08] National Identity No.: NEEDS-YOU. Enter your Philippine national ID (PhilSys) number if you have one, or leave it blank if you don't.
- [B09] Other names used to enter/leave Korea: NEEDS-YOU. Tick No or Yes. If Yes, give the other name.
- [B10] Citizen of more than one country: NEEDS-YOU. Tick No or Yes. If Yes, give details.

**2. PASSPORT INFORMATION**
- [B11] Passport Type: Regular [√] (I've assumed an ordinary passport, so change this if yours is diplomatic or official)
- [B12] Passport No.: ID_P1
- [B13] Country of Passport: PHILIPPINES
- [B14] Place of Issue: AUTHORITY_P1
  - This is the issuing authority as printed (for example a DFA office or a Philippine embassy). If the form checker wants a city, write just the city or post named in it.
- [B15] Date of Issue: ISSUED_P1
  - For consistency, rewrite it as yyyy/mm/dd like the other dates.
- [B16] Date of Expiry: 2032/03/13
- [B17] Any other valid passport: NEEDS-YOU. Tick No or Yes. If Yes, give its type, number, country and expiry date.

**3. CONTACT INFORMATION**
- [B18] Home Country Address: NEEDS-YOU. Give your address in the Philippines.
- [B19] Current Residential Address: ADDRESS_P1
  - I've assumed ADDRESS_P1 is your Singapore address, since you live there. If it's actually your Philippine address, move ADDRESS_P1 to 3.1 and write your Singapore address here.
- [B20] Cell Phone No.: PHONE_P1
  - If the stored number has no country code, add it in front (+65 for a Singapore number, +63 for a Philippine one).
- [B21] Telephone No.: leave blank if you have no landline
- [B22] E-mail: NEEDS-YOU. Give your email address.
- 3.6 Emergency Contact
  - [B23] Full Name: NEEDS-YOU. Give your mother's full name in English.
  - [B24] Country of Residence: PHILIPPINES
  - [B25] Telephone No.: NEEDS-YOU. Give your mother's phone number, with +63 in front.
  - [B26] Relationship: MOTHER

**4. MARITAL STATUS AND FAMILY DETAILS**
- [B27] Current Marital Status: Single [√]
- [B28]–[B33] Spouse details: leave blank (only for married applicants)
- [B34] Children: No [√]. Number of children: leave blank (or 0)

**5. EDUCATION**
- [B35] Highest level of education: Bachelor's Degree [√]
- [B36] Name of School: NEEDS-YOU. Give the school where you got your nursing degree.
- [B37] Location of School: NEEDS-YOU. Give its city/province/country.

**6. EMPLOYMENT** (this means your situation now, not the Seoul job)
- [B38] Current personal circumstances: NEEDS-YOU. Tick the box that fits now, most likely Employed if you're working in Singapore.
- [B39] Name of Company/Institute: NEEDS-YOU. Give your current employer.
- [B40] Position: NEEDS-YOU. Give your current job title (for example Staff Nurse).
- [B41] Address of Company: NEEDS-YOU. Give your current employer's address.
- [B42] Telephone No.: NEEDS-YOU. Give your current employer's phone number.
- If you're not working right now, tick Unemployed or Other (and explain) and leave 6.2 blank.

A few final checks before you submit:
1. The form must be in block letters, so write every name and address in CAPITALS when you copy them in.
2. Make sure your name, date of birth and passport number match your passport exactly.
3. Ask your Seoul employer whether they want both your Philippine and Singapore addresses filled in. Most do, since you live outside your home country.
